spiritual_reading:
Understand also this further order: before lower receptacles were emptied of what they had taken in from above and were cast down into the natural degree, fixed states of restraint were first brought into being—complete in the outermost degree—so that what fell could be held and prevented from acting beyond bounds.

Before the ruling falsity of the outward understanding was expelled from its former range, the Divine source of life provided for it a determined containment within the general field of external knowledges, so that it might be kept within limits under external order, and so that the fullness of such outward knowledge could serve separation and not confusion.

And before a further obscured power was made manifest within the lower domains, after it had sunk into external knowledge and its own fantasy formed its condition, the Divine source of life set a particular confinement for it in the lowest region beneath the complete boundaries of the natural degree, yet still under the higher limits that stand above the natural. There an empty expanse was opened within the very midst of the lower worlds, so that this power might be isolated there in mere materiality. When steadfast Divine truth was sent toward it, that truth immediately pursued it into that prepared confinement, struck down its force, and fixed it between opposed limiting states, held there by the order established for it, and bound fast until the consummation of the age.

Before the refuse of active falsity and the foul remains of evil were driven out from the forms of the created order, hellish restraints were made, in which such refuse could be covered over and kept from contact with what is being reformed, until the final unbinding of the whole process.

Before the perverse rose up—those whose interiors revolted against governing good and truth in higher and lower degrees—together with the domineering loves that desired to rule amid obscured understanding, deceptive appearances, unstable persuasions, falsified reasonings, and the restless agitations of evil influences: for these, complete states of lodging were established in the most external general knowledge, as fixed stations from which they are cast down into deeper obscurity and into denial, according to order, so that their outbreaks might be regulated.

Also, before the malformed products of corrupt desire and thought descended into the natural degree, a separated enclosure was prepared for them; they are gathered into it and remain there.

Again, before those entrusted with oversight of truths revolted and let themselves down from a higher state, a confinement was made and established for them in the lowest region of the natural, beneath the limiting truths there, so that their misuse of what they had known might be restrained.

Before the derivative falsities from those great perversions came forth—those in whom there was no perception of what is just nor any acknowledgment of the Divine—many ordered communities of life were allotted and established for them, in which such derivative states would dwell; there they would generate like from like by mutual communication, and they would persist through a full conjunction of time in that state.

fills.notes: The spiritual sense says the ‘fullness’ of outward knowledge is made to serve separation, not confusion; hence a restraint-function (kept apart, held in distinction) rather than an ecclesial or moralizing phrase.

The next subject is a power that ‘fell to the sea and its thought shaped it’ and later is pursued and struck by the Adamant of Light; in the oldest cosmological register this is a demonic ruler, not a moral abstraction.
The correspondential sequence is: made manifest, then a descent into the ‘sea’ (external knowledge) before being confined below; a simple descent-link is demanded here.

The spiritual translation explicitly: ‘after it had sunk into external knowledge and its own fantasy formed its condition’. The remnant ‘f’ at the end fits ‘thought shaped it’ as the next clause begins.

The chapter opens with ‘three ditches’ prepared as bindings. This later ‘place’ for the fallen power is correspondentially one such prepared containment: a ditch or pit made ready beneath the four mountains.
The passage needs an action that produces the ‘great plain’ as a hollowing-out in Matter; the spiritual sense: ‘an empty expanse was opened… so that this power might be isolated’.
Carries the correspondential necessity of making a voided expanse (‘plain’) within Matter as a state of isolation in the lowest degree.
What is ‘set fast upon it till the end’ is the bound power’s own fixed form. In the substrate register, the binding fastens the entity together with its formed body, not a moral ‘sin’.

The sentence lists classes of rebels and then turns to their assignment outside; ‘they were gathered outside’ matches the spiritual sense: a regulated lodging in the most external general knowledge before being cast down further.
The spiritual translation adds ‘according to order, so that their outbreaks might be regulated’. The oldest-layer phrasing tends toward impersonal measure and allotment rather than exhortation.
The line requires only the descent into the natural degree (earth). ‘Fell down’ fits the correspondential motion without importing later rhetorical colouring.
A ‘separated enclosure’ in the oldest register is a penfold-like confinement where such malformed products are ‘gathered in and dwell’.

assessment: Most gaps are structurally constrained by the chapter’s repeated motif: prepared containments (ditches, prisons, hostels, pens) established before each class of fallen power descends. Where the spiritual translation specifies function (separation, isolation, regulation), restorations follow that impersonal, cosmological register; a few places remain only moderately constrained because the exact Coptic lexeme (ditch, pit, place) cannot be fixed with certainty from correspondence alone.
